mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.role, u.auth_cd, a.auth_nm, u.display_name, u.created_at, u.note, u.profile_image FROM app_users u LEFT JOIN fd_auth a ON a.auth_cd = u.auth_cd ORDER BY u.created_at ASC, u.username ASC

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.role, u.auth_cd, a.auth_nm, u.display_name, u.created_at, u.note, u.profile_image FROM app_users u LEFT JOIN fd_auth a ON a.auth_cd = u.auth_cd WHERE u.id = #{id}

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.password, u.role, u.auth_cd, a.auth_nm, u.display_name, u.created_at, u.note, u.profile_image FROM app_users u LEFT JOIN fd_auth a ON a.auth_cd = u.auth_cd WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_users (id, username, password, role, auth_cd, display_name, created_at, note, profile_image) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{password}, #{role}, #{authCd}, #{displayName}, #{createdAt}, #{note}, #{profileImage})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_users SET username = #{username}, password = #{password}, role = #{role}, auth_cd = #{authCd}, display_name = #{displayName}, note = #{note}, profile_image = #{profileImage} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE app_users SET profile_image = #{profileImage} WHERE id = #{id}
